{{Top|leg}}
The '''En'Tra''' ("King-Master"), formally the '''En'Tra'Sol'Tais'Tra''' ("King-Master of Law, Land and Cities"), was the ultimate ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the En'Tra was [[Im'Toral XV]].
